services.desc: After reviewing our camps below, click the Program Notes and FAQ buttons above get a full overview of our programs. Join us on a magical, adventurous journey from the Russian Imperial Palace to the sparkling streets of Paris. In this fast-paced musical camp, performers build acting, singing, and dance skills while diving into the sweeping story of Anastasia. Perfect for new and experienced performers alike, this camp invites every young artist to discover their courage, their voice, and the magic of telling a great story.
